name: dms-spotlight-tasks
description: Dev tooling for the Spotlight Tasks DMS plugin; DMS itself never reads this file

scripts.reload: dms ipc call plugin-scan reload spotlightTasks
scripts.add: dms ipc call tasks add 'from the ipc bus'
scripts.test:hyprland: dms-testbed run hyprland --plugin . && dms-testbed open hyprland '+ '
scripts.test:niri: dms-testbed run niri --plugin . && dms-testbed open niri '+ '
scripts.test:reload: dms-testbed reload hyprland spotlightTasks; dms-testbed reload niri spotlightTasks
scripts.test:shot: mkdir -p screenshots; dms-testbed shot hyprland screenshots/hyprland.png; dms-testbed shot niri screenshots/niri.png
